about.text: A soft, washed-rind farmhouse cheese of raw sheep's or goat's milk from the Calenzana area and the Balagne in Haute-Corse. It is about 400 g a unit and sharp in flavour; an older-style version is called Calinzanincu vecchju.

sources.text: The type, milk, origin, size, flavour and older variant, from this article.
